_note: Atelier Network configuration example only. Not deployed. All runtime flags disabled. Replace all placeholder values before use.
_legal: LEGAL-REVIEW-REQUIRED items listed in docs/AUTOMOTIVE_RISK_REGISTER.md must be resolved before any production activation.

roles._note: Network and workshop roles. All roles are disabled in ATN-0. Activation requires explicit authorisation per workshop and per organisation.

NETWORK_SUPER_ADMIN.description: Full platform read/write access across all workshop organisations. Every action audit-logged.

ORGANIZATION_OWNER.description: Full access within one workshop organisation. Cannot access other organisations.

WORKSHOP_MANAGER.description: Operational management of one workshop site — staff, appointments, work orders, reports.

SERVICE_ADVISOR.description: Customer intake, appointment management, work order creation and follow-up.

TECHNICIAN.description: Access to work orders and interventions assigned to them. Cannot access other technicians' work orders.

INSPECTOR.description: Perform and record AutoCheck inspections. Read-only on work orders. Cannot manage appointments.

CASHIER.description: Invoice and payment management within one workshop. Cannot access inspection or repair details.

READ_ONLY_AUDITOR.description: Read-only access across one organisation for audit purposes. No write, no delete.

API_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.description: Machine-to-machine credential for external integrations (EXTERNAL_CONNECTED mode).

workshop_types._note: Supported workshop types. Used in atn_workshops.workshop_type.

integration_modes._note: How a workshop connects to the Atelier Network platform.

modes.NATIVE_MANAGED: Workshop uses Atelier Network platform natively for all operations
modes.EXTERNAL_CONNECTED: Workshop keeps its own software; connects via Atelier Network API for data exchange
modes.HYBRID: Uses Atelier Network for some functions (e.g. inspection reporting), external for others (e.g. invoicing)

integration_modes.fixpert_mode: TBD — to be confirmed in ATN-1. Fixpert is the first pilot and operates an external system predating this platform.

autocheck._note: AutoCheck is the provider-neutral inspection standard governed by Mythos Atelier Network.

smart_gate._note: Each participating workshop owns its Smart Gate device and consent/notice obligation. ID Auto owns the resulting vehicle observation. No Smart Gate devices connected in ATN-0.

idauto_api.note: Read vehicle_id for work order and inspection linkage

autovaleur_api.note: Inspection data consumed by AutoValeur for post-inspection valuation — activation in ATN-1

event_bus.note: Workshop domain events — design only in ATN-0. Implementation in ATN-1.

access_scopes._note: Canonical scope names. Same as ecosystem-level. Workshop operational data is organization_private.

mythos_private.description: Mythos Network Super Admin only — audit-logged

organization_private.description: One workshop organisation — no cross-org access

feature_flags._note: All flags false in ATN-0. Activation requires stage completion and explicit authorisation.

operating_rules.workshop_data_isolation: Each workshop organisation cannot access another organisation's data
operating_rules.id_auto_vehicle_id_required: All work orders and inspections must reference a vehicle_id from ID Auto
